messages.content: Set up a beginner Teach Mode exercise at 120 BPM with C4, D4, and E4 on consecutive beats. Make each bar one beat long.

tools.name: load_lesson
tools.description: Create or replace the visible Teach Mode exercise in a ready state. Use beat-timed notes; after success, the learner starts it from the page.

bpm.description: Lesson tempo from 40 to 240 beats per minute.

notes.description: Target notes with key or Western note, start beat, and visible duration in beats.

tools.name: get_lesson_progress
tools.description: Read the visible Teach Mode result summary and one bounded page of note outcomes. Use nextCursor to continue when more results remain.

tools.name: clear_lesson
tools.description: Clear the visible Teach Mode exercise and return the page to its empty lesson state. Use when the learner wants a fresh exercise.
